evals.prompt: Describe how I write and give me a prompt template so Claude can write like me. https://thepipeandtheline.substack.com
evals.success_criteria: Loads brand-voice first, reads full article text and notes, and returns a voice profile plus a reusable prompt template.
evals.rubric: The answer contains a voice profile, a style breakdown with do's and don'ts, and a prompt template for writing in the author's voice. It is specific to this author's real writing and could not describe any other newsletter.
